programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The screams of Cassius Clay in his final days can still be heard reverberating through the walls of White Hall. Caretakers have had their belief in the supernatural shifted ever since they began spending time at the site.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Morgan Fairchild, Lili Taylor, John Salley, Vincent Curatola
programme.desc: A young Morgan Fairchild is abused by a spirit when she moves into her new husband's family home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Michael Imperioli, Joan Collins, Donna D'Errico, Corey Feldman
programme.desc: Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel; & more.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tracey Gold, Alice Cooper, Fred Dryer, Katherine Erbe
programme.desc: The spirit of a lonely child seeks refuge with Tracey Gold; and more.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Billy Baldwin, Tempestt Bledsoe, Tracy Nelson, Eric Balfour
programme.desc: A stay at a desolate hotel confirms Billy Baldwin's belief in the other side.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).
En kræftpatient (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) overvinder alle odds med hjælp fra sin bedste ven (Seth Rogen), sin mor (Anjelica Huston) og en ung terapeut (Anna Kendrick).

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en meget succesfuld sælger, stresser over at få en stor handel. For at hjælpe hende skal hun slå sig sammen med Jonathan, der har travlt med at skabe en magisk jul til sin kæreste. Konflikten er givet, men noget andet begynder også at gry...

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv er i fuldstændig frit fald. Hendes døtre driver hende til vanvid, og hendes utaknemmelige chef løber ud af hende, mens hendes mand forlader hende.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk aften i deres afsides hus vågner Emma lænket til sin døde mand. Hun er fanget, afskåret fra omverdenen og må kæmpe mod lejemordere for at undslippe sin mands forskruede plan.

programme.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
programme.desc: En motorcyklist påbegynder et liv med kriminalitet for at kunne forsørge sønnen, som han ikke vidste, han havde. Han bliver i mellemtiden forfulgt af en idealistisk politimand.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dans på barbermaskinen
programme.desc: Da Mutant X og Genomex bliver fanget på film ved hjælp af deres kræfter, må de begge tage sig af den journalist, der planlægger at offentliggøre oplysningerne.

programme.title: Mutant X: ex markerer stedet
programme.desc: Shalimars tidligere kæreste dukker op og forsøger at genfinde et Fabergé-æg, der indeholder en mikrochip med ekstraordinære kræfter.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Livet efter døden og døden
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Cairo, Egypten, og derefter i Amsterdam. De skal slå den rivaliserende relikviejæger Avery Ko til farao Thutmose's diamant, før den bliver skåret op og solgt.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Ætset i sten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Stewie Harper tager til Stockholm i Sverige for at finde kong Jann I af Norges runesten.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Dublin i Irland for at finde den sidste irske konges forsvundne krone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fireworks

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Joanna Cassidy
programme.desc: Actress Joanna Cassidy (Blade Runner, Six Feet Under) seeks out the help of psychic medium Kim Russo to find out who has been haunting her 1800s-era home in Natchitoches, LA.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Anthony Michael Hall
programme.desc: Actor Anthony Michael Hall (The Breakfast Club, Sixteen Candles, The Dead Zone) seeks the help of medium Kim Russo.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Orlando Jones
programme.desc: Comedian and actor, Orlando Jones (Sleepy Hollow) revisits the North Carolina hotel where he had a paranormal experience so frightening that it forced him to flee in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Margaret Cho
programme.desc: Comedienne and actress, Margaret Cho (Drop Dead Diva) returns to the house in Peachtree, Georgia where she experienced such a terrifying and violent energy that the memory continues to haunt her today.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Swingers: Swingers
programme.desc: I denne morsomme indie-komedieklassiker, der startede karrieren for et enestående sæt skuespillere, sætter to venner sig for at omdanne moderne dating fra Los Angeles til Las Vegas.

programme.title: Notorious
programme.desc: Datteren af en dømt nazistisk spion bliver bedt af amerikanske agenter om at indsamle oplysninger om en ring af nazistiske videnskabsmænd i Sydamerika. Hvor langt skal hun gå for at infiltrere dem?

programme.title: My Week with Marilyn
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe er det forrige århundredes absolut største kvindelige ikon og er omgivet af en nærmest mytisk aura. Nu vækkes hun til live i 'My Week With Marilyn', der er baseret på virkelige hændelser.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animeret film med GEORGE CLOONEY og MERYL STREEP som Mr. og Mrs. Fox, der leveret lykkeligt familieliv med den excentriske søn(JASON SCHWARTZMAN) og nevøen Kristofferson,som er på besøg.

programme.title: Ernest in the Army
programme.desc: Ernest melder sig til hæren, så han kan køre store lastbiler, men ender med at blive sendt i krig! Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: En udlejer har mistanke om, at hendes nye logerende er galningen, der dræber kvinder i London.

programme.title: Exit Through the Giftshop
programme.desc: Banksys dokumentarfilm om street art, der udforsker en franskmands forsøg på at lave en film om Banksy.

programme.title: Miami Supercops
programme.desc: Superstrømerne Doug Bennet (Terence Hill) og Steve Forest (Bud Spencer) forsøger at finde udbyttet fra et gammelt kup, da en af bagmændende bliver løsladt efter at have afsonet sin straf på 11 års fængsel.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie er en marketingchef, som vender tilbage til sin hjemby, da hun uventet bliver værge for sin niece og nevø. Mens hun er der, genoptager hun kontakten med Cooper, hendes ungdomskæreste.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En tyv med en unik, professionel etik bliver bedraget af sin bande og efterladt til at dø. I en ny forklædning, og i en alliance med en kvinde, leder han efter bandens seneste udbytte fra et kup.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: En forsvindende kunst
programme.desc: Sammen med tryllekunstneren Max rejser Sydney og Nigel til Atlantic City i New Jersey på jagt efter Ungarns forsvundne og angiveligt forbandede kongelige scepter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Andromeda: Exitstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr styrter ned efter at være undsluppet en bande nietzscheanere, men står snart over for en ny trussel: Rev's behov for at spise.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Paranormal enthusiasts have theorized that Somerset County’s enthralling paranormal finds may have more to do with the geomagnetic anomalies present in its unique land that yield results which are fascinating to some and terrifying to others.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Oliver Stones film om Edward Snowden er en nervepirrende skildring af de virkelige hændelser, der ledte frem til, at Snowden måtte gå i eksil, da han lækkede fortrolige dokumenter om sikkerhedsbureauet NSA og deres ulovlige overvågningsteknikker.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way. In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: De kalder mig Trinity - Djævlens højre hånd
programme.desc: Den seje dusørjæger Trinity (Terence Hill) beslutter at besøge sin halvbror Bambino (Bud Spencer), der ernærer sig som hestetyv og plattenslager.

programme.title: Mclintock!
programme.desc: John Wayne spiller hovedrollen som kvægbaronen George Washington McLintock, der kæmper med sin kone, datter og politiske jordbesiddere, kun for i sidste ende at »tæmme« dem alle.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: En by i staten Washington vågner til det surrealistiske syn af udenlandske soldater i faldskærme, der daler ned fra himlen. Uden varsel er USA er blevet invaderet, og denne by er det første mål.

programme.title: Tokarev
programme.desc: Da datteren af en tidligere kriminel bliver kidnappet, samler han sit gamle hold og forsøger sig med sin egen form for retfærdighed.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dødeligt begær
programme.desc: Holdet forsøger at forhindre Eckhart i at skaffe sig et sjældent element, men en tyv får fat i det. Kvinden, der har evnen til at få mænd til at blive forelsket i hende, har Brennan i sigte.

programme.title: Mutant X: En race for sig
programme.desc: Mutant X møder en ny fraktion af Nye Mutanter kaldet Strand, der ledes af den magtfulde første mutant Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X: Fortid som prolog
programme.desc: I et desperat forsøg på at redde sit eget liv genopliver Ashlocke en gammel egyptisk alkymist, som udgør en dødelig trussel mod Mutant X-holdet.

programme.title: Mutant X: magtspil
programme.desc: Holdet kæmper for at gøre en militær oberst, der har truet med at udløse et nukleart holocaust, ukampdygtig.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2

programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Stewart is Missing / Yard Sale
programme.desc: Mrs. Stevenson shows up at Butt-head's house, desperate to enlist their help in finding Stewart. / Tom Anderson get Beavis and Butt-head to watch his yard sale, and the boys manage to sell everything when they take the sale inside.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Tainted Meat / Bad Dog
programme.desc: Beavis and his bacteria ridden "thingy" contaminate the food at Burger World. / Beavis and Butt-head adopt a vicious dog at a shelter and it trains them.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A Very Special Episode / Dumbasses Anonymous
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head come to the aid of a wounded baby bird...almost. / Beavis and Butt-head show up at an AA meeting hoping to score some booze.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Nektet service / Balleskvis
programme.desc: Beavis prøver yogabukser og får dem ikke av. / Guttene oppdager at de har rett til å nekte service til kunder på Burger World.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: The Mystery of Morning Wood / U.S. History
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to stay awake all night, in an attempt to discover the secret behind morning wood. / For his oral report on an historical figure, Beavis recounts the valuable lessons he learned one night while eating at Burger World.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: En spirituell reise
programme.desc: Beavis ser ansiktet til Jesus i en nacho-chips. Det sender ham på en episk reise for å finne svar på det store spørsmålet - "Hvorfor får jeg aldri pult?"

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Nose Bleed / Vaya Con Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Coconut Nut Clusters
programme.desc: The deputies raise money selling delicious Coconut Nut Clusters door-to-door.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Back in Black
programme.desc: Dangle reconnects with his family after his estranged father passes away.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover at Burger Cousin
programme.desc: Rick the Burger Cousin manager is a cruel taskmaster when deputies go undercover flipping burgers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Wall
programme.desc: Garcia and Junior help build a wall to keep Mexicans from crossing into America illegally.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Death of a Pickle-Thrower
programme.desc: Jackie, the pickle-throwing hooker, spends her twilight hours with the Reno Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Baghdad 911
programme.desc: Iraqi police force cadets learn law enforcement skills from Reno's finest, and Dangle and Wiegel destroy a huge cocaine supply.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Tanning Booth Incident
programme.desc: Dangle learns that free tanning sessions for law enforcement aren't necessarily a good thing.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Strong Sister
programme.desc: Strong Sister magazine visits the station for an in-depth profile on Williams, and the deputies enforce Reno's six-foot rule for lap dances.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Dad Returns
programme.desc: While the deputies investigate Reno's Thai sex trade, Wiegel's long-lost father returns to reconnect with his daughter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
programme.desc: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own
programme.desc: A playwright makes characters come to life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programme.desc: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Equipped with new insight into the Kentucky Anomaly and a bevy of compiled evidence of paranormal phenomena, the team returns to the Conrad-Caldwell Museum.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Brennans’ legacy begins and ends in their enchanting Old Louisville home: nearly every member of the Brennan clan perished within its walls or had their funeral service held here.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The screams of Cassius Clay in his final days can still be heard reverberating through the walls of White Hall. Caretakers have had their belief in the supernatural shifted ever since they began spending time at the site.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animasjonsfilm basert på en historie avnorskættede Roald Dahl. Herr og fru Rev leveret idyllisk liv, men herr Rev begynner å kjennepå sine dyriske instinkter.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: Down Terrace
programme.desc: Etter å ha sonet fengsel for en mystisk forbrytelse, slipper Bill og Karl seg ut av fengselet og blir opptatt av å finne ut hvem som leverte dem til politiet. På toppen av det, er "familiebedriften" på steinene

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om den irske jagerpiloten Brendan «Paddy» Finucane, som bare 21 år gammel ble tidenes yngste oberstløytnant i Royal Air Force, og som skvadronsjef et av de største og mest berømte flyveressene i andre verdenskrig.

programme.title: Elizabethtown
programme.desc: Den fremadstormende designeren Drew Baylor får livet snudd på hodet en skjebnesvanger dag. På vei til Elizabethtown møter Drew Claire, som har bestemt seg for at hun er den rette jenta for å vise Drew veien hjem igjen.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun trives som en smart, men ufokusert surfer, helt til han oppdager en roman av den anerkjente forfatteren Martin Skinner. Han blir inspirert, og forlater Orange County for å studere kreativ skriving ved Stanford University.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: Pete Bell, en college-baskettrener, er under mye press. Laget hans vinner ikke. Fremtidens stjerner blir betalt av andre lag. Denne praksisen er forbudt i college-spillet, men Pete er desperat og har press fra alle sider.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen er en amerikansk racersjåfør i 24-TIMERSLØPET PÅ LE MANS i denne heseblesende originalfilmen, som er filmet på Le Mans-banen, med bilstunt som gir deg hakeslepp og action som får hjertet til å banke.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Love Letter
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Frankrike for å lete etter de tapte bryllupsløftene til Josephine Pontoise og Guy de Bourdin, noe som skulle bevise at arvingen er den rettmessige eieren av St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: A Good Year
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel reiser til Frankrike for å finne de tapte steinene fra Marie Antoinettes krone.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nothing But the Truth
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel blir gjenforent med Stewie Harper i jakten på sannhetens kalk i Frankrike.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Paris, Frankrike etter sverdet til Jacques de Molay, stormester for tempelridderne. Rival relikviejeger Rita Rosellini er også ute etter sverdet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjertet av reisen (del 1)
programme.desc: Beka tar Andromeda til Tarn-Vedra, men lengre tid i slipstream forårsaker bivirkninger. For å bekjempe dem, begynner Beka å ta Flash og blir snart avhengig.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Parade
programme.desc: The Carson City Parade Float Contest brings out the deputies' competitive spirit.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Training Day

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences

programme.title: The Stepford Wives

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Harlan County Courthouse was both sanctuary and execution site. The town hub that witnessed a brutal revenge killing and countless trials of corrupt lawmen is the site of the country's most haunted building.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Vince Neil
programme.desc: Vince Neil returns to the home where he last came into contact with the spirit of his four-year old daughter. The journey becomes an emotional roller coaster as Kim Russo discovers Vince is being followed by a dark energy.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Vanessa Williams
programme.desc: Kim visits Vanessa Williams (Desperate Housewives, Ugly Betty) at her home in Westchester, NY and discovers that the escalating paranormal encounters she's experiencing are being caused by two entities who met tragic, untimely deaths.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Pennhurst Revisited
programme.desc: Kim has an attached entity that has been adversely affecting her life. She believes it came from her last visit to Pennhurst Insane Asylum when filming The Haunting of...Beverly Mitchell.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å kickstarte karrieren, regisserer og spiller en psykotisk skuespiller hovedrollen i et Broadway-stykke som blir en usannsynlig suksess etter at han prøver å skyte seg selv i hodet under premieren.

programme.title: The Motorcycle Diaries (Diarios De Motocicleta)
programme.desc: Følg Ernesto "Che" Guevaras liv på et livsforandrende road trip gjennom Sør-Amerika.

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: En mann flytter med kona og datteren fra storbyen til sitt drømmehus i utkanten av en småby, langt unna all kommunikasjon. Timingen kunne imidlertid vært bedre da det viser seg at verden holder på å kollapse.

programme.title: Den siste gentleman
programme.desc: Robert Redford spiller bankraneren Forrest Tucker. Som 70-åring rømmer han fra fengsel og begår en rekke bankran. Men den ene skatten han virkelig drømmer om er hjertet til Jewel, og det skal vise seg å bli Forrests mest utfordrende kupp noensinne.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jacques er eier av en hardbarket bar i New York som fungerer som et slags hjem for et broket utvalg av profesjonelle drankere. Jacques prøver målbevisst å drikke og røyke seg til døde når han møter Lucas, en hjemløs, ung mann som allerede har gitt opp…

programme.title: Midnight in Paris
programme.desc: Paris om morgenen er vakker. Paris om ettermiddagen er sjarmerende. Paris om kvelden er fortryllende. Men - Paris etter midnatt er magisk!

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: The Bells Of St Mary's
programme.desc: At a big city Catholic school, Father O'Malley and Sister Benedict indulge in friendly rivalry, and succeed in extending the school through the gift of a building.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dens time kommer 'Runde endelig
programme.desc: Et gammelt minne fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uhell, noe som sender henne på oppdrag og etterlater Dylan ved siden av mannskapet ikke i stand til å overstyre kommandoen.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Widinging Gyre
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie må redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdensskip.

programme.title: Andromeda: Utgangsstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr krasjer land etter å ha rømt en gjeng Nietzscheans, men møter snart en ny trussel: Revs behov for å mate..

programme.title: Mutant X: Deadly Desire
programme.desc: Teamet prøver å stoppe Eckhart fra å skaffe seg et sjeldent element, men en tyv får det. Kvinnen som kan få menn til å bli forelsket i henne, setter blikket mot Brennan.

programme.title: Mutant X: A Breed Apart
programme.desc: Mutant X møter en ny fraksjon av New Mutants kalt Strand, ledet av den kraftige første mutanten Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.desc: I Los Angeles skuggsida – långt ifrån neonljus och berömmelse – kämpar fyra separata människor en kamp mot ett ensamt och tröstlöst liv.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: Två ensamma själar finner kärlek och en förbindelse mitt i storstadens kaos. En hjärtevärmande berättelse om konst, udda existenser och humor.

programme.title: The WAY, WAY BACK
programme.desc: 14-årige Duncan tvingas tillbringa sommarlovet med sin mamma Pam, hennes påfrestande pojkvän Trent och hans dotter Steph. Det är en utmaning för Duncan att passa in i den nya familje­konstellationen.

programme.title: Året jag slutade prestera och började onanera
programme.desc: Hanna är mitt i livet och sin karriär och vill ha ett andra barn med Morten, men han gör slut med henne. Plötsligt står hon utan jobb, lägenhet och sin bästa vän Carro.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunneln i slutet av ljuset
programme.desc: Med femtio partier ombord är Dylan värd för undertecknandet av stadgan för det nya samväldet, men upptäcker snart att det finns inkräktare som är fast beslutna att stoppa undertecknandet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Under krigets täckmantel
programme.desc: Shalimar skickas undercover i en dödlig högteknologisk lönnmord-ring för att hitta varför de vill ha Adam död.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Room 7 and The Beta Incident
programme.desc: A man lives in an abandoned bed and breakfast, while fixing it up as an investment property. A woman returns to the scene of a mysterious incident in search of answers.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Witching Hour and The 13th Step
programme.desc: A couple moves to a house in the deep woods only to learn that they won't be getting the peace and quiet they wanted. A recovering alcoholic struggles to figure out if her horrifying visions are real or a symptom of withdrawals.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Dream House and Ghost Month
programme.desc: A woman's recurring nightmare comes to life in her new house. A single mother fears for her son's life after moving into a new house.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Joanna Cassidy
programme.desc: Actress Joanna Cassidy (Blade Runner, Six Feet Under) seeks out the help of psychic medium Kim Russo to find out who has been haunting her 1800s-era home in Natchitoches, LA.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Anthony Michael Hall
programme.desc: Actor Anthony Michael Hall (The Breakfast Club, Sixteen Candles, The Dead Zone) seeks the help of medium Kim Russo.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: What Maisie Knew
programme.desc: Wallace har precis blivit bedragen av sitt livs kärlek när han träffar Chantry. När Chantrys pojkvän Ben tvingas flytta i jobbet kommer Wallace och Chantry närmare varandra och Wallace överväger att berätta för Chantry hur han verkligen känner.

programme.title: I morgon börjar allt
programme.desc: Samuel, en man vars bekymmerslösa liv på Franska Rivieran vänds upp och ner när Kristin, som han haft en kortare romans med, plötsligt dyker upp och presenterar honom för deras nyfödda dotter Gloria. Kristin överlämnar Gloria med varm hand i hans vårdnad.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: En sista semester
programme.desc: En nostalgisk road movie av Paolo Virzì (Girighetens pris, Galna av lycka) baserad på boken av Michael Zadoorian. En sista semester nominerades till Guldlejonet i Venedig 2017.

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Den legendariske komikern Andy Kaufmans liv och karriär.

programme.title: Misbehaviour
programme.desc: År 1970 gjorde en grupp kvinnor upp en plan för att sabotera världens största skönhetstävling, Miss World - för att driva patriarkatet av scenen och vända det skeva skönhetsidealet upp och ner.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: När en gruva kollapsar i Kanada fångas en grupp gruvarbetare. Nu måste Jim hitta långtradarförare som kan transportera räddningsutrustning via farliga isvägar över frusna vatten innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Ruskiga Rekryter - In war with the army
programme.desc: Alvin (Jerry Lewis) och Vic (Dean Martin) är kompisar som söker värvning i armén, främst därför att Vic har problem med sin flickvän och söker sig via det militära till en tjänstgöring i Europa.

programme.title: Supersnooper
programme.desc: Terence Hill är den nyutbildade polismannen Dave Speed, som ska inkassera en parkeringsbot mitt i ett oländigt träskområde. Tyvärr är det också platsen för ett topphemligt atombombsprov.

programme.title: Mutant X: Verklighetskontroll
programme.desc: Shalimar hamnar i trubbel när teamet möter en mutant från kalla kriget som har förmågan att förändra verkligheten och förstöra människors sinnen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Återuppvaknande
programme.desc: Teamet hjälper besättningen på en havsforskningsstation som hotas av en förhistorisk varelse som man tidigare trodde var utdöd.

programme.title: Mutant X: För att han inte ska bli
programme.desc: Shalimar går motvilligt med på att kontakta sin främmande far när teamet får reda på att hans företag sysslar med genetiska tester och manipulationer.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Skattkammarön
programme.desc: Sydney är på jakt efter en pirats byte, men kommer en förrädare att tvinga henne att gå på plankan?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nadirs stjärna
programme.desc: En anonym sultans hustru Danielle dör under mystiska omständigheter i öknen. Hon hade dock bett Sydney om hjälp. Sydney tror att Danielle sökte efter Nadirs stjärna.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.desc: As he's trying to celebrate his birthday, Al is put on trial by a group of obese women.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Stepford Peg

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Bud On The Side
programme.desc: Al's boss falls in love with Bud.

programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Sporting goods / Cow tipping

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get drunk off non-alcoholic beer and fail a sobriety test. / Beavis and Butt-head are allowed to watch a film for girls about teen pregnancy. The titillation ends abruptly during the birthing sequence.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Nose Bleed / Vaya Con Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Meet God
programme.desc: Innocent, naive yougsters Beavis & Butt-head are drawn into an insidious religious cult.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Shortcuts / Late Night with Butt-Head / Butt, Butt Hike!
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head miss the schoolbus home / The duo makes a Late Night Show / Beavis and Butt-Head are invited to play football

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Shopping cart / Die Fly, Die! / Drinking Butt-ies
programme.desc: Our duo find out that accidents can lead to money / Beavis and Butt-Head get annoyed at a fly / After a beating by Todd, they become best friends over beer

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel Suicide Watch
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine Gets Married
programme.desc: Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Anniversary
programme.desc: The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Moving Day
programme.desc: Dangle needs help moving out of his house, and Junior teaches Reno's youth about prison life.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 2
programme.desc: The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Halloween
programme.desc: On Halloween, the deputies prepare for a night of mayhem, and Wiegel sets a sting operation to catch mischievous teens.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Promotion
programme.desc: Dangle gets a new job in Carson City, but the deputies are too wrapped up in women's basketball to give him a proper send-off.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: Wiegel's new boyfriend, Craig, bears an uncanny resemblance to the Truckee River Serial Killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programme.desc: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programme.desc: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programme.desc: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
programme.desc: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programme.desc: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programme.desc: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Orlando Jones
programme.desc: Comedian and actor, Orlando Jones (Sleepy Hollow) revisits the North Carolina hotel where he had a paranormal experience so frightening that it forced him to flee in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Margaret Cho
programme.desc: Comedienne and actress, Margaret Cho (Drop Dead Diva) returns to the house in Peachtree, Georgia where she experienced such a terrifying and violent energy that the memory continues to haunt her today.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Lauded as “The Mecca of Paranormal Investigation”, Waverly Hills is purportedly home to spirits who are not shy to interact with visitors who frequent its massive halls, with decades’ worth of inexplicable finds documented by various investigators.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: One of Tennessee''s most respected thoroughbred horse farms, the Rose Mont was built by Judge "Jo" Conn Guild, where his family resided for generations. Today, it operates as a wedding and event venue where guests have claimed to spot apparitions.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Tennessee's first maximum security prison was a glorified slave labor camp that treated inmates as single use units of labor. Miners were left to die during cave-ins, and the facility was known as "the end of the line."

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: När den amerikanska poeten Elizabeth Bishop drabbas av skrivkramp i början av 1950-talet bestämmer hon sig för att resa till Brasilien. Där träffar Elizabeth arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares och de blir snart attraherade av varandra.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: En dag besöks den pensionerade bibliotekarien Joan Stanley av brittiska säkerhetstjänsten som arresterar henne för spioneri. Alla omkring Joan chockas av att denna stillsamma dam misstänks för att vara en av de mest inflytelserika spionerna i historien.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: Den "svarta får"-sonen av en förmögen familj möter en ung psykiatrisk patient som har växt upp i isolering hela sitt liv. Han tar med sig denna naiva unga kvinna hem till sin brors bröllop.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers tillvaro faller samman när två biffiga killar dyker upp: en sexig nu klasskamrat och hennes tråkige med snygge före detta styvbror. Nu får hon lära sig att ifråga om kärlek är hon helt borta.

programme.title: Sångklubben
programme.desc: Kvinnorna på en militärbas i England försöker styra sinnet från sina bekymmer och tanken på en kör tar form. Men ingen av dem hade förväntat sig att uppträda i Royal Albert Hall...

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen medverkar i denna gripande och roliga berättelse om en pappa med en annorlunda inställning till föräldraskapet som blir tvungen att visa den moderna världen för barnen.

programme.title: Storfräsarna
programme.desc: Terence Hill och Bud Spencer får dubbelgångare. Tur att två av dem kan slåss! De rika kusinerna Antonio och Sebastiano är två brasilianska mångmiljonärer som lever i skräck för yrkesmördare. Därför anställer de två dubbelgångare.

programme.title: Nu ger vi järnet
programme.desc: Helt otroligt! Trinitybrorsorna har fått jobb. Som piloter! Mitt i amazonas djungler. Mitt bland ett gäng diamantskurkar som är det värsta gäng rövare världen skådat näst vår regering.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Vampyrernas kyss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, en babe-magnet, professor och romanförfattare ber Sydney om hjälp med att hitta Vlad Tepes förlorade relik. Och han är inte den enda som är ute efter den.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Djävulsdocka
programme.desc: En guide leder Sydney och Nigel till en ovanlig, underjordisk aztekisk gravkammare. I stället för en kropp hittar de en relik.

programme.title: Andromeda: Om hjulet är fast
programme.desc: Beka och Tyr tas över av energin från en dimensionell tunnel. Dylan, Trance och Harper måste rädda dem innan de förstör skeppet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skärvor
programme.desc: Dylan blir anklagad för mord och måste rentvå sitt namn samtidigt som han hittar delarna till en vas som sägs ge ägaren "kosmos välsignelser".

programme.title: Andromeda: Galet att bli räddad
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en grupp flyktingar, men upptäcker att de har utsatts för regeringsexperiment och är extremt instabila.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fire Fighters Are Jerks

programme.title: RENO 911!: Security for Kenny Rogers

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Owned and operated by the same caretakers of Old South Pittsburg Hospital, Harriman presents a unique opportunity for the team to delve further into the study of hospital phenomena.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: Jimmy P.
programme.desc: En orolig indianveteran bildar en exceptionell vänskap med en fransk psykoanalytiker när de försöker hitta botemedel mot deras lidande.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The United States is one of the most profitable drug markets in the world. For ruthless and sophisticated drug traffickers, it is truly the land of opportunity.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: They were a gang of criminal masterminds. They carried automatic weapons and were not afraid to use them. With each and every new heist, they became bolder and more deadly, until the FBI stepped in, determined to end their violent rampage.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: Ett par i kris försöker rädda sitt förhållande på en helgresa.

programme.title: The Pallbearer
programme.desc: Nothing like death to put some life in romance: a hapless 25-year-old's fortunes change when he is a pallbearer for someone he doesn't know. David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Supersnooper
programme.desc: Terence Hill är den nyutbildade polismannen Dave Speed, som ska inkassera en parkeringsbot mitt i ett oländigt träskområde. Tyvärr är det också platsen för ett topphemligt atombombsprov.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekkas farbror kandiderar till ett ämbete i det nya samväldet, men ett mordförsök får besättningen att agera som hans säkerhetsvakt.

programme.title: Mutant X: I den månlösa natten
programme.desc: I den spännande säsongsstarten kommer de överlevande medlemmarna av Mutant X ut ur en dödlig explosion och möter Lexa, som får dem att börja ifrågasätta grundläggande antaganden om sin värld.

programme.title: Mutant X: Syndens lön
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet måste stoppa auktionen av en mycket dödlig substans som ett antal ökända internationella terrorister vill ha.

programme.title: Mutant X: Rasen
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet tas in för att hjälpa en militärbas som har smittats av en dödlig sjukdom.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: How To Marry A Moron
